revocation_reason: The source-locked compact alternate27 RankBounds certificate did not match its immutable workflow artifact. In particular, four of the six generation-1 targets were assigned rank<=1 evidence belonging to different alternate models of the same branch. Therefore generation 1 receives no closure or audit-promotion credit, even where RationalPointsGenus2 independently returned complete=true.
corrective_action: The alternate27 compact certificate is repaired directly from artifact 9828202890, the six target lock is rebuilt with the exact favorable alternate model for each branch, and a fresh run-key generation is required before re-execution.
